title: Brickworks Lofts
summary: Four flats in the old brickworks. Two hundred twenty dollars a month is left after the mortgage.

title: Old Cannery
summary: The waterfront cannery, split into workshops. Four hundred eighty dollars a month clears the note.

title: Ridge Orchard
summary: Hillside rows of apple trees with a packing barn. One hundred forty dollars a month is left after the note.

title: Lantern Yard
summary: A courtyard of rooms that needs new wiring. The mortgage outruns the rent by eighty dollars.

title: Lantern Ferry
summary: The dawn ferry and its ticket booth. Three hundred twenty dollars a month is left after the note.

title: Kiln and Clay
summary: A pottery workshop bought with cash. It pays one hundred eighty dollars a month and owes nothing.

title: Night Market Hall
summary: A covered hall of evening stalls. Seven hundred fifty dollars a month remains after the loan.

title: Tide Press Bindery
summary: A bindery that finishes the tide tables. Two hundred sixty dollars a month is left after the note.
